title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: Practice the set plays
hook: What happens when the other team bunts with a runner on first?
intro: Three players chase it and no one covers first.
statement: A simple plan turns confusion into an out.
q1: Do you practice a few set plays —
q2: or let kids figure them out in games?
q3: How many runs come from plays nobody covered?
t1: Both can work. But restarts help
t2: when every player knows where to go.
cta: Coaches — do you practice set plays?
ctaLines: Bunt coverage. First and third. Cutoffs and relays.
ctaPrompt: Share your practice habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What happens when the other team bunts with a runner on first?
The ball rolls toward third. Three players chase it and no one covers first.
A simple plan turns confusion into an out.
Practice set plays or let kids figure it out. There is no perfect answer.
Do you practice set plays? Share your habit in the comments.
